bank.title: Get an Excel formula you can actually test
bank.hook: You know what you want the spreadsheet to do but not how to write the formula.
bank.problem: Describing the result you want beats guessing at function names.
steps: Describe your columns and one example row (fake or anonymised values).
Say what the formula should return, in one sentence.
Test it on three rows where you already know the answer.
bank.prompt: My sheet has these columns: [letter: what it holds, for example A: date, B: type, C: amount]. In [cell] I want [the result, for example the total of C where B is 'Retail']. Give me an Excel formula for [cell] and explain it in one sentence.
checks: It works on three rows whose answers you know.
It still works when a cell is blank.
bank.mistake: Pasting real customer rows to 'show' the data.
bank.privacy: Do not paste customer or company data into an AI tool.
